properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the add-in was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified OMathArgs object.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns the number of items in the OMathArgs collection. Read-only Long.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns an OMath object that represents the specified item in the collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: Specifies the ordinal position of the object within the collection.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Inserts an argument into an equation with variable number of arguments (OMathDelim and OMathEqArray objects) and returns an OMath object.

parameters.name: BeforeArg
parameters.description: An existing argument before which to add the new argument.
